keyPoints.en: Weather = short-term; climate = long-term average (about 30 years).
keyPoints.bm: Cuaca = jangka pendek; iklim = purata jangka panjang (kira-kira 30 tahun).

keyPoints.en: Instruments: thermometer (Stevenson screen), rain gauge, wet-and-dry bulb thermometer, barometer, anemometer, wind vane.
keyPoints.bm: Alat: termometer (skrin Stevenson), tolok hujan, termometer bebuli basah dan kering, barometer, anemometer, ram-ram angin.

keyPoints.en: Northeast Monsoon (about Nov–Mar): heavy rain and floods on the east coast.
keyPoints.bm: Monsun Timur Laut (kira-kira Nov–Mac): hujan lebat dan banjir di pantai timur.

keyPoints.en: Southwest Monsoon (about May–Sept): drier for much of the Peninsula (sheltered by Sumatra).
keyPoints.bm: Monsun Barat Daya (kira-kira Mei–Sept): lebih kering bagi kebanyakan Semenanjung (dilindungi Sumatera).

keyPoints.en: Inter-monsoon: afternoon convectional thunderstorms. Relief rain falls on windward slopes.
keyPoints.bm: Peralihan monsun: ribut petir perolakan pada waktu petang. Hujan bukit turun di cerun menghadap angin.

keyPoints.en: Equatorial climate: about 26–32 °C, over 2 000 mm rain, humidity around 80%.
keyPoints.bm: Iklim khatulistiwa: kira-kira 26–32 °C, melebihi 2 000 mm hujan, kelembapan sekitar 80%.

keyPoints.en: Highlands are cooler because temperature falls with altitude.
keyPoints.bm: Tanah tinggi lebih sejuk kerana suhu menurun dengan ketinggian.
